# Repo-owned nlohmann/json production source

The unmodified `include/`, `cmake/`, top-level `CMakeLists.txt`, `LICENSE.MIT`, `LICENSES/`, `.reuse/dep5` and `README.md` come from [nlohmann/json](https://github.com/nlohmann/json) commit `55f93686c01528224f448c19128836e7df245f72`, the former gitlink pin. The production headers identify MIT and retain their individual notices; the retained `.reuse/dep5` records the source project's per-path license mapping. This note is Enroth Continuum metadata.

This is a deliberately scoped production-source and CMake copy. Tests, tools and docs are omitted from this fork's MM7 build; in particular, the upstream test-only GPL `imapdl` files are not present. The original upstream license texts are retained for provenance. No JSON behavior was changed.
